sources.entry: Gantry - Docker management client for local and SSH remote hosts with built-in MCP server support for agent workflows. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/getgantry/gantry) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Gantry is a native SwiftUI macOS app for managing Docker containers, images, volumes and networks on the local daemon and remote hosts over SSH, with a built-in MCP server for AI agents.
summary.what_it_does: Gantry manages and monitors the local Docker daemon and any number of remote Docker hosts reached over SSH, plus apple/container hosts on the Mac. It covers container lifecycle, image build/pull/tag/prune, volumes, networks, Docker Compose projects with a YAML editor, and a Smart Cleanup panel for reclaiming disk space. It offers live logs with regex search, stats charts, and a Docker-events-driven UI. Remote hosts connect like `docker -H ssh://`, using ~/.ssh/config, ProxyJump, and Keychain-stored secrets. It also includes an exec terminal, a debug sidecar shell for containers without a shell, a file browser, port forwarding, and Cloudflare Tunnel sharing. A bundled gantry-mcp binary and App Intents let agents and Shortcuts drive the same hosts.
use_cases: manage Docker containers on a Mac
monitor remote Docker hosts over SSH
let an AI agent control Docker via MCP
share a local dev server publicly via Cloudflare Tunnel
debug distroless containers with a sidecar shell
how_to_run: open Gantry.xcodeproj  # Xcode 26+, build the "Gantry" scheme
notable: Native macOS app with no Electron; works with Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima, or plain remote dockerd
Remote SSH hosts run `docker system dial-stdio` with no server-side install beyond Docker
Bundled gantry-mcp stdio server exposes containers, images, volumes, Compose and tunnels to AI agents
Support for apple/container hosts, including Compose orchestration and custom kernels
Debug shell attaches a toolbox sidecar sharing the target container's namespaces without modifying it
caveats: Not notarized; first launch needs right-click Open or clearing quarantine, and Sparkle updates go through Homebrew
ECDSA private keys in OpenSSH format are not supported
Remote hosts need docker on PATH for dial-stdio
